seo.description: Learn about Common Cold — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: The common cold is a viral upper respiratory infection, usually self-limiting within 7–10 days. Antibiotics are not effective. Symptomatic care and hydration are the mainstay of treatment.
causes: Coronaviruses, adenoviruses, and other respiratory viruses
diagnosis: Differentiate from influenza, COVID-19, or bacterial sinusitis if symptoms prolonged or severe
treatment: Saline nasal drops or steam inhalation
prevention: Avoid touching face with unwashed hands

faqs.question: What causes Common Cold?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Common Cold curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Severe ear pain or facial swelling
